description: Rooflights to stair and new mezzanine shower room.  Replacement of rear garden doors.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

<span id="docs-internal-guid-23d4ed3f-7fff-4c66-adec-0d0c93ac9fdc"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed roof lights must be conservation-style and sit flush with the existing roof slope.</span></p><br><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area.</span></p><div><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;"><br></span></div></span>

<p>All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture, notwithstanding the details of the approved plans.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>

REASON:&nbsp;To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the conservation dwelling and area.</p>
